jobs.title: Director of Marketing Technology (Multi-Solution Architect)
jobs.description:
Bounteous is a global AI Services firm where agentic engineering and human experience converge to deliver transformative business outcomes for the enterprise. We help organizations design, build, and scale AI-driven products, platforms, and processes. With more than 5,000 team members worldwide, Bounteous delivers AI that sticks, powering adoption and outcomes that move organizations from experimentation to true transformation. Bounteous is backed by New Mountain Capital, a New York-based growth-oriented investment firm that emphasizes business building.

Bounteous is seeking a Director of Marketing Technology to serve as a senior, consultative Multi-Solution Architect within our Digital Experience Platforms practice. This role is designed for a seasoned marketing technology leader who combines deep platform expertise with strong client advisory skills, and who is equally comfortable shaping strategy, architecting solutions, and contributing directly in a billable capacity across client engagements.

While Adobe Experience Cloud represents a dominant ecosystem within the Bounteous practice, this role is intentionally multi-platform. The Director is expected to bring strong Adobe expertise alongside working knowledge of complementary marketing technology platforms and patterns, including CRM, CDP, marketing automation, analytics, and personalization technologies. The role spans both B2B and B2C use cases, with an emphasis on data-driven orchestration, lifecycle marketing, and measurable business outcomes rather than CMS- or DAM-centric implementations.

This position serves as a bridge between sales and delivery, acting as a trusted advisor to clients and platform partners while also setting delivery teams up for success. The Director balances strategic leadership with hands-on, billable client work, helping clients modernize their marketing technology ecosystems and extract long-term value from their platform investments.

Information Security Responsibilities

Promote and enforce awareness of key information security practices, including acceptable use of information assets, malware protection, and password security protocols
Identify, assess, and report security risks, focusing on how these risks impact the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets
Understand and evaluate how data is stored, processed, or transmitted, ensuring compliance with data privacy and protection standards (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
Ensure data protection measures are integrated throughout the information lifecycle to safeguard sensitive information

Role And Responsibilities

Multi-Solution Architecture and Strategy

Serve as a senior, consultative marketing technology architect across multiple platforms and solutions
Lead the design of scalable, data-driven marketing technology architectures that support both B2B and B2C customer journeys.
Architect solutions spanning CDP, marketing automation, journey orchestration, analytics, personalization, and CRM integrations.
Provide architectural guidance across dominant Adobe platforms as well as complementary technologies where appropriate.
Translate business objectives into platform architectures, data models, integration patterns, and activation strategies.
Maintain awareness of evolving MarTech capabilities, ecosystem trends, and emerging technologies.

Client Advisory and Billable Delivery

Act as a trusted, consultative advisor to client stakeholders, guiding platform selection, roadmap planning, and architectural tradeoffs.
Maintain an active billable role across client engagements, contributing directly to discovery, solutioning, and delivery oversight.
Lead client workshops, discovery sessions, demos, and executive presentations.
Partner with delivery teams to ensure solutions are implemented in alignment with architectural intent and best practices.
Support escalation, troubleshooting, and course correction on complex marketing technology programs.

Pre-Sales, Growth, and Partnerships

Partner with client service and business development teams to support pursuits, pitches, and account expansion.
Support pre-sales solutioning through consultative discovery, estimates, and solution narratives.
Identify opportunities to create packaged offerings, accelerators, and repeatable solution patterns
Collaborate with platform partners, including Adobe and other MarTech vendors, on roadmap awareness, co-innovation, and solution alignment.

Governance, Enablement, and Thought Leadership

Guide clients in establishing marketing technology governance models, operating models, and Centers of Excellence.
Define best practices for data stewardship, consent management, orchestration, and measurement.
Provide thought leadership in the marketing technology space, helping position Bounteous as a trusted partner for enterprise MarTech transformation.
Mentor architects and senior practitioners, contributing to internal enablement, frameworks, and best-practice playbooks.

Preferred Qualifications

Preferred Qualifications

10 or more years of experience designing, architecting, and delivering marketing technology solutions.
3 or more years of experience in a digital-first, global delivery agency or consultancy.
Deep experience with Adobe Experience Cloud, including platforms such as Adobe Experience Platform, Journey Optimizer, Marketo Engage, Customer Journey Analytics, and related tools.
Working knowledge of non-Adobe MarTech platforms such as Salesforce, Braze, Iterable, or similar, with the ability to architect across ecosystems.
Strong understanding of CRM, CDP, analytics, identity, and data integration patterns.
Proven ability to operate in a consultative, client-facing role while maintaining billable delivery responsibilities.
Demonstrated success translating complex technical ecosystems into measurable business outcomes.
Excellent executive communication skills with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

$157,000 - $227,000 a year

Individual pay is determined by many factors, including experience, relevant education or training, and organizational needs. The mid-range to maximum of the salary range is generally reserved for individuals who are highly experienced in the role.

Bounteous is willing to sponsor eligible candidates for employment visas.

jobs.title: Managing Director, Head of FX Operations - COO Group
jobs.description:
Job Description

What is the opportunity?

Royal Bank of Canada is seeking an experienced Managing Director to lead our enterprise Foreign Exchange (FX) Operations function. This is a strategic leadership role overseeing FX settlement, clearing, trading support, and operational infrastructure across all business lines and global centers. You will drive operational excellence, manage enterprise-wide FX operations governance, and ensure world-class service delivery while maintaining the highest standards of regulatory compliance and operational risk management. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to shape the future of RBC's FX operations, lead a talented global team, and make a significant impact on one of the bank's most critical business functions.

What will you do?

Develop and execute enterprise FX operations strategy and governance frameworks aligned with regulatory requirements and RBC Group standards; establish strategic priorities and drive continuous improvement initiatives
Oversee FX settlement and clearing operations across all currency pairs and markets, including pre-settlement matching, SWIFT messaging, nostro account management, and clearinghouse interactions; ensure settlement integrity and minimize settlement risk
Direct FX trading support services including order management, trade execution support, client confirmations, and settlement coordination; ensure timely and accurate trade processing
Establish and maintain comprehensive operational and settlement risk controls, counterparty credit limits, and compliance procedures aligned with OSFI, FINTRAC, and international standards
Manage and develop a high-performing team of FX operations professionals across global centers; foster a culture of operational excellence, risk awareness, and continuous improvement
Oversee FX technology platforms, trading systems, settlement systems, and risk management infrastructure; identify and implement system enhancements to improve efficiency and resilience
Establish incident management and business continuity procedures; ensure timely resolution of operational issues and regulatory compliance
Collaborate with global markets trading teams, treasury, risk management, and external counterparties; serve as senior point of contact for FX operations matters with leadership and regulators
Drive performance metrics and reporting on settlement success rates, operational efficiency, and risk indicators; provide regular updates to senior management on operations performance and strategic initiatives

What do you need to succeed?

Must-have :

Minimum 12 years of progressive experience in FX operations, trading support, or settlement operations, with at least 6 years in a senior leadership or management capacity at a tier-1 global financial institution
Deep expertise in FX trading operations, settlement procedures, clearing processes, SWIFT standards, and nostro account management
Proven track record building and leading high-performing operations teams in a complex, fast-paced trading environment
Strong understanding of financial services regulations including OSFI guidance, FINTRAC requirements, and international FX market standards
Demonstrated expertise in operational and settlement risk management, with ability to establish effective controls and governance frameworks

Nice-to-have:

Master's degree (MBA or equivalent)
SWIFT certification, Certified Treasury Professional (CTP), or Certified Financial Risk Manager (FRM) designation
Experience with post-trade infrastructure, market infrastructure provider standards, or emerging technologies in operations (blockchain, distributed ledger technology)
Background with RBC or other tier-1 global banks in FX or treasury operations

What’s in it for you?

We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits, competitive compensation
Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
Work in a dynamic, collaborative, progressive, and high-performing team
Opportunities to do challenging work
Flexible work/life balance options

Job Skills

Adaptability, Critical Thinking, Customer Service, Detail-Oriented, Financial Engineering, Financial Statement Analysis, Investments Analysis, Personal Development, Personal Initiative, Teamwork

jobs.description:
About Long Life Capital

Long Life Capital Inc. ("LLC") is a Montreal-based strategic advisor to institutional investors and a private equity investment manager. Founded in 2022, the firm works with pension funds, sovereign wealth funds, asset managers and corporations on transaction execution, investment underwriting, and strategic projects.

Transaction Advisory
| we support institutional investors evaluate investment opportunities, from thesis development and underwriting to financial modelling, due diligence and transaction execution.

Strategic Projects
| we advise institutional investors and corporations on long-term strategic initiatives for their organizations, such as redesigning underwriting frameworks, developing fund-wide strategies and improving investment processes.

Investing
| we pursue investments on a principal basis through our separate managed account (SMA) strategy, through which we have >$100M of assets under management.

The Role

LLC is seeking a Senior Associate or Vice President to join its team in Montreal. The successful candidate will work across all three areas of the business. The role offers direct client exposure, meaningful responsibility, and the opportunity to help build a growing firm.

Title:
Senior Associate / Vice President
Location:
Montreal, Quebec
Experience:
5 to 10 years in investing or transactions

Qualifications

Required

5 to 10 years of experience in private equity, principal investing, investment banking, transaction advisory, or consulting
Demonstrated deal experience across the transaction lifecycle
Strong understanding of private investments, including valuation, structuring and scenario analysis
Advanced financial modelling skills, including responsibility for complex transaction models
Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill complex analysis into concise investment recommendations
Sound judgment and the ability to work with incomplete information on tight timelines
Undergraduate degree in commerce, finance, economics, engineering or a related field
Fluency in English and/or French

Assets (considered a plus, not a must)

Experience in infrastructure, energy, power or renewables
Experience working with institutional investors
Proficiency using AI for analytical purposes
CFA, CPA or MBA

What We Offer

Direct exposure to senior decision makers at leading institutional investors
A broad mandate spanning transaction advisory, strategic projects and principal investing
A small, collaborative team where each member's contribution is visible
Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

How to Apply

Interested candidates should send a CV to info@longlifecapital.ca. All applications will be treated confidentially.

jobs.title: Customer Success Director
jobs.description:
This employer is an HR technology company seeking a Director of Customer Success Managers to own gross retention and net revenue retention across its named and higher-value accounts. Reporting to the VP of Global Customer Success, you will lead a global organisation of managers and customer success managers who protect the customer base, manage renewals and drive expansion.

The Role

• Lead, hire and coach managers of customer success across multiple regions and time zones.
• Set and manage coverage models by account tier, own the annual re-tiering of books and standardise tier-specific playbooks.
• Oversee renewals across the portfolio and move legacy evergreen agreements to standard contractual terms.
• Lead the weekly and monthly risk and churn review with revenue leadership, keeping real-time health signals and remediation plans for at-risk accounts.
• Set rules of engagement with account management, and report retention, net revenue retention and portfolio risk to executive leadership.

What You'll Need

• 10+ years of experience in customer success or account management within B2B SaaS or global services, including 5+ years leading people managers.
• A proven record of protecting and expanding a large customer book with measurable gains in gross and net retention.
• Experience leading distributed teams across regions and designing tiered coverage models, playbooks and scalable operating frameworks.
• Strong executive presence and fluency with Salesforce and customer health data platforms; HR tech, payroll or global expansion experience is preferred.

What's On Offer

• Annual fixed pay of CAD 140,000 – CAD 175,000, plus variable compensation tied to retention.
• Medical, dental and vision insurance, spending accounts, generous paid parental leave and flexible time off.
• A remote-first team, with a sabbatical after five years.

jobs.title: Director, Sales & Business Development - Defense
jobs.description:
Director of Sales & Business Development - Defense

We are hiring for a Director to lead our Sales and Business Development function by developing and executing commercial strategies that drive sustainable revenue growth, expand market share, strengthen customer relationships, and position the Company for long-term success in domestic and international defense markets.

The Director is responsible for business development, capture management, strategic planning, proposal leadership, market intelligence, strategic partnerships, customer engagement and commercial execution while ensuring alignment across Engineering, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain and Finance.

Location:
Mississauga, ON

Salary
: $175,000 - $200,000 plus incentives

Please note that the salary range information provided is a general guideline only, reflecting a position based in Ontario. Criteria such as the candidate’s qualifications and relevant experience, the scope of the specific position, as well as market and business considerations will be evaluated when extending an offer.

We Take Care of Our People

RRSP with Employer Match I Health and Wellness Benefits I Learning and Development Opportunities I Competitive Pay I Referral Program I Recognition I Employee Stock Purchase Plan I Inclusive & Supportive Culture

Curtiss-Wright invests in the development, recruitment, and retention of critical skills as part of its model for business success. We offer a competitive wage, a comprehensive benefit package, RRSP, tuition reimbursement, and paid vacation/holidays.

Your Challenge

Direct control of departmental operating budget. Member of the Senior Management Team responsible for contributing to annual sales, bookings, profitability and strategic business objectives.
Develop and execute the Company’s annual and long-range Sales & Business Development strategy aligned with corporate growth objectives.
Develop and maintain a rolling three-to-five-year opportunity pipeline including opportunity qualification, capture strategy, customer engagement plans, probability of win, pricing strategy and executive action plans.
Lead capture activities for all strategic pursuits from early customer engagement through contract award.
Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with customers, government agencies, strategic partners, sales representatives and key industry stakeholders.
Ensure the Voice of Customer is routinely captured, communicated throughout the organization and incorporated into strategic planning, product development and operational decision-making.
Develop market entry strategies for new products, technologies and international markets.
Identify and establish strategic partnerships that improve market access, local content capability and competitive positioning.
Own the Company’s competitive intelligence process by monitoring customer priorities, competitor activities, technology developments and procurement trends.
Lead the Company’s Price-to-Win process for strategic opportunities, ensuring pricing strategies balance competitiveness, profitability and probability of award.
Provide executive leadership and oversight for the preparation of all major proposals and quotations, ensuring submissions are compliant, competitive, technically sound and delivered on schedule.
Chair proposal reviews and commercial gate reviews for major opportunities.
Work closely with Engineering to ensure product development priorities are aligned with validated customer requirements and future market opportunities.
Lead cross-functional pursuit teams involving Engineering, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, Quality and Finance to ensure coordinated execution of strategic opportunities.
Lead commercial negotiations for major contracts and strategic agreements while ensuring compliance with corporate policies and customer requirements.
Develop annual sales forecasts, bookings forecasts and market assessments to support business planning.
Mentor, coach and develop members of the Sales & Business Development organization while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Ensure all employees perform their work in accordance with the Company’s Quality Management System (QMS).
Take every reasonable precaution to protect the health and safety of employees including:
Establishment of safe work procedures.
Education and orientation of employees.
Appointment of competent supervision.
Performance of workplace inspections.
Immediate reporting and investigation of incidents.
Corrective action for unsafe conditions.

Functional Areas Reporting to this Position

Sales Managers
Business Development Managers
Proposal Manager
Contracts Manager
Spares Administrator
Sales Administrator
Estimator
Strategic Capture Lead (future)

What You Bring

Minimum ten (10) years of progressive leadership experience in Sales, Business Development or Capture Management within the defense, aerospace or related industries.
Demonstrated success by securing complex domestic and international defense programs.
Strong understanding of Canadian, U.S. and international government procurement processes.
Proven experience leading strategic capture efforts from opportunity identification through contract award.
Experience developing commercial strategies, Price-to-Win analyses and competitive assessments.
Strong understanding of proposal management, contract negotiations and commercial risk management.
Demonstrated ability to build executive-level customer relationships with military, government and industry stakeholders.
Experience working within cross-functional organizations involving Engineering, Operations, Program Management and Finance.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and presentation skills.
Strong analytical, commercial and financial acumen.
Ability to think strategically while driving disciplined execution.
Willing and able to travel internationally as required.

Minimum Education Requirements

Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Business Administration, Commerce or a related discipline.
MBA or equivalent business education is considered an asset.

Key Performance Measures

Annual Bookings
Qualified Opportunity Pipeline
Proposal Win Rate
Gross Margin at Award
Price-to-Win Discipline
Customer Satisfaction
Market Share Growth
Strategic Partnership Development
Forecast Accuracy
Business Development Team Performance

Who We Are

Our Values

Environmental, Social and Governance

Curtiss-Wright's INDAL facility combines a high level of engineering and manufacturing capability with expertise in the management of large and complex defense programs to produce specific solutions for the world's navies. With over 50 years of experience, we lead in the design and development of ship-borne helicopter handling systems, undersea sensor handling systems and specialized on-deck structures.

https://electro-mechanicalsystems.curtisswright.com/indal

Our employees are highly motivated, self-starters and able to work in a fast-paced team environment where critical and tight deadlines are common, and Customer Satisfaction is our foremost mission.

No unsolicited agency submittals please. Agency partners must be invited to participate in a search by our Talent Acquisition Team
and have signed terms in place prior to any submittal. Resumes submitted directly to any Curtiss-Wright employee or affiliate will not qualify for fee payment, and therefore become the property of Curtiss-Wright.

Compliance Statement

This position may require exposure to export-controlled information and subject to additional security screening. In the event information provided during the security screening reveals ineligibility to access export-controlled information, any offer of employment may be reconsidered or withdrawn.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, color, sexual orientation, gender identity, physical or mental disability, age, ancestry, legally protected medical condition, family care status, marital status, religion, veteran status, national origin, or any other legally protected status. If you require accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact Talent Acquisition.

Your Challenge

Direct control of departmental operating budget. Member of the Senior Management Team responsible for contributing to annual sales, bookings, profitability and strategic business objectives.
Develop and execute the Company’s annual and long-range Sales & Business Development strategy aligned with corporate growth objectives.
Develop and maintain a rolling three-to-five-year opportunity pipeline including opportunity qualification, capture strategy, customer engagement plans, probability of win, pricing strategy and executive action plans.
Lead capture activities for all strategic pursuits from early customer engagement through contract award.
Establish and maintain executive-level relationships with customers, government agencies, strategic partners, sales representatives and key industry stakeholders.
Ensure the Voice of Customer is routinely captured, communicated throughout the organization and incorporated into strategic planning, product development and operational decision-making.
Develop market entry strategies for new products, technologies and international markets.
Identify and establish strategic partnerships that improve market access, local content capability and competitive positioning.
Own the Company’s competitive intelligence process by monitoring customer priorities, competitor activities, technology developments and procurement trends.
Lead the Company’s Price-to-Win process for strategic opportunities, ensuring pricing strategies balance competitiveness, profitability and probability of award.
Provide executive leadership and oversight for the preparation of all major proposals and quotations, ensuring submissions are compliant, competitive, technically sound and delivered on schedule.
Chair proposal reviews and commercial gate reviews for major opportunities.
Work closely with Engineering to ensure product development priorities are aligned with validated customer requirements and future market opportunities.
Lead cross-functional pursuit teams involving Engineering, Operations, Program Management, Supply Chain, Quality and Finance to ensure coordinated execution of strategic opportunities.
Lead commercial negotiations for major contracts and strategic agreements while ensuring compliance with corporate policies and customer requirements.
Develop annual sales forecasts, bookings forecasts and market assessments to support business planning.
Mentor, coach and develop members of the Sales & Business Development organization while fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration and continuous improvement.
Ensure all employees perform their work in accordance with the Company’s Quality Management System (QMS).
Take every reasonable precaution to protect the health and safety of employees including:
Establishment of safe work procedures.
Education and orientation of employees.
Appointment of competent supervision.
Performance of workplace inspections.
Immediate reporting and investigation of incidents.
Corrective action for unsafe conditions.
